_comment: Intended differences between the DWC 3.7 page (dwc-src, Vue 3) and the DWC 3.6 page (dwc36, Vue 2), read by tests/lines-divergence.test.js. only37 = exists only in dwc-src, only36 = only in dwc36. Exact sets: an entry that matches nothing any more fails the test (the lines converged: delete it); anything not listed is drift and fails. dwc36_vs_master lists the files of dwc36 that are not byte-equal to master's dwc-src. Porting the 3.7 fixes to 3.6 is an owner decision (docs/DWC-LINES.md).

files.reason: 3.7-only modules of the Vue 3 port: dwc-host.js (the one place that touches DWC 3.7 internals), the role composable use-role.js and expand-transition.js (<v-expand-transition> is not registered in DWC 3.7; Vue 2 / DWC 3.6 registers it, so dwc36 keeps the plain tag). 3.6-only: role-mixin.js, the Vue 2 mixin that does what use-role.js does for the page bar (PageHeader.vue). role-view.js and plugin-id.js (shared by PageHeader.vue) exist on both lines. Porting is an owner decision (docs/DWC-LINES.md); since the 3.7 line was paused (owner decision 2026-11-04) only 3.6 receives work, so the 3.6-only list also holds the modules of the roles card, the Start-up wizard and section, the SD files viewer, the bridge contract dialog, the shared help/notice/lock/error pieces and the range picker (Vue 2 pieces with no 3.7 port yet)

dwc36_vs_master.reason: both lines share the texts: the catalogs are copied from dwc-src/i18n (written by dsf/published_texts.py), master's are older; the startup card was redesigned on both lines (StartupMaster.vue, startup-groups.js; ProcessesSummary.vue and WorkshopService.vue: one count list for the processes strip, chips and title chip, 'not available' while the service is not connected (U-05); 'master' here is the tag pre-dwc-3.7, the last state of the old 3.6 page); the camera relay control (2026-11-04: RelayCard.vue and camera-relay.js, the relay is a process of the service; index.js offers its bar tile; ProcessRow.vue shows the card; a Vue 2 / Vue 3 pair) and the design family (2026-10-28, Service 2.21.13): family.css / plugin-colors.js / theme.css / SideTabs.vue and the new shared pieces PageHeader.vue, page-health.js, service-problem.js, shared-t.js, plugin-id.js, role-mixin.js, role-view.js (copies of TallerPlugins vue/_shared36), and every component restyled to the family (no side bars, tints, shadows or colored icons; page bar instead of the title card); also the work done on 3.6 only after the 3.7 pause: roles card and matrix, Start-up wizard and section, SD files viewer, bridge contract dialog and port, shared help / notice / lock / error / range pieces, session state and reset, process settings and groups, and the resulting edits of the pages that host them

i18n.en.reason: 3.6-only texts of the pieces listed under files (roles, start-up wizard, SD files, bridge contract, shared help/notice/range/lock/error pieces) and of 3.6-only processes-page rows; the 3.7 line is paused so its catalog is not refreshed. The 18 texts that only 3.7 had (svc.main_* process names, heartbeats_paused_from_page, procDocs.auto_air_* and auto_lights_*, keys.pattern_covers) were copied into dwc36/i18n because the service publishes those svc keys and the 3.6 page translates them, except the 7 texts that the 3.6 page dropped on purpose (procDocs.auto_air_* and auto_lights_*, keys.pattern_covers: the rows of the processes page and the key page no longer show them; tests/process-settings.test.js and tests/api-keys-caps.test.js pin that they are gone), which stay only in 3.7; the svc keys published after that copy were copied too. 3.6-only also holds the texts of the Access screens (area access) and the lights json error text

i18n.es.reason: 3.6-only texts of the pieces listed under files (roles, start-up wizard, SD files, bridge contract, shared help/notice/range/lock/error pieces) and of 3.6-only processes-page rows; the 3.7 line is paused so its catalog is not refreshed. The 18 texts that only 3.7 had (svc.main_* process names, heartbeats_paused_from_page, procDocs.auto_air_* and auto_lights_*, keys.pattern_covers) were copied into dwc36/i18n because the service publishes those svc keys and the 3.6 page translates them, except the 7 texts that the 3.6 page dropped on purpose (procDocs.auto_air_* and auto_lights_*, keys.pattern_covers: the rows of the processes page and the key page no longer show them; tests/process-settings.test.js and tests/api-keys-caps.test.js pin that they are gone), which stay only in 3.7; the svc keys published after that copy were copied too. 3.6-only also holds the texts of the Access screens (area access) and the lights json error text

operations.reason: service operations that only the 3.6 page calls (air.auto/delay, bed zones, roles, start-up plan/apply/files, close sessions, service restart, key preview); the 'processes.' entry is the prefix of a computed operation name. The 3.7 page is paused and has no port of these screens

i18n_bytes.reason: the catalogs are no longer byte-equal: dwc36/i18n carries the 3.6-only texts listed under i18n.en / i18n.es and five reworded sign-in texts (startup_master.sum_login, startup_master.login_row, api.signInNeeded, users.never_expires_help, shared.header_sign_in); the 3.7 catalog is paused. The key sets are still compared above
